Our mission
Sustainable, safe and nutritious food for all in a continuous changing world.
Our vision
To produce high-quality graduates that are creative, knowledgeable and innovative who can promote industry, academia, and/or government organizations to guarantee availability and access to food for the coming generations.
To provide assistance to the stakeholders linked to Food Science and Technology through workshops, demonstrations and seminars.
To lead and promote cutting edge research in the field of Food Science and
Technology to help food industries and consumers.
C
a
reer Opportunities
Food is eaten all over the world and has great future prospects in industrialized nations, such as America, Europe, Australia, China and Middle East. In Pakistan, a food scientist can acquire a job in,
Agricultural Provincial & Federal Government Departments
Research Organizations
Multinational & Local Food Industry
Public & Private Sector Food Testing Laboratories
Food Regulatory & Certification Organizations
Food Authorities
Colleges and Universities
Small Business Development Agencies
Dairy Development Sector
Hotel Industry
Food Ingredient Suppliers
In the mentioned fields a Food Scientist can work as,
Food Inspector
Quality Control and Quality Assurance Officer
Production and Processing Manager
New Product Development Manager
Lecturer & Professor
Hence, there are more job opportunities for a Food Science graduates compared to most of the fields.
